text: Correction to my earlier 'clean' verdict on #5338: a slower background verification pass I'd already kicked off finished after I reported and found a real finding, posted as PR comment. CHANGELOG.md/agent-handoff.md's new entries cite requirement range '#1074 and #1147-#1150' for the six moved test families, but MinButton's actual requirement ID (per the test code's own comments) is #1155 -- never cited. Same class of documentation-citation gap as #5336's evidence mismatch. Sorry for reporting clean too early -- I'll wait for all spawned sub-agents to finish before declaring a review done going forward. Not fixed, your branch, still open.
